findings.message: Container nginx does not set runAsNonRoot: true
findings.nextAction: Set securityContext.runAsNonRoot to true at pod or container level

findings.message: Container nginx does not set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
findings.nextAction: Set securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation to false on every container

findings.message: Deployment omits pod and container securityContext settings
findings.nextAction: Add pod-level securityContext defaults where appropriate
Add resources.limits for memory and CPU to each container

findings.message: Deployment containers omit resource requests; HPA and scheduler decisions will be unreliable
findings.nextAction: Set resources.requests.cpu and resources.requests.memory on every container

findings.message: Container nginx does not set readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
findings.nextAction: Set securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem to true on every container

findings.message: Container nginx does not drop ALL capabilities
findings.nextAction: Set securityContext.capabilities.drop to ["ALL"] on every container

findings.message: Deployment does not set automountServiceAccountToken: false; pods get unnecessary API credentials
findings.nextAction: Set automountServiceAccountToken to false in the pod spec
Add pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce label with baseline or restricted value

findings.message: Deployment has replicas: 1; no high availability
findings.nextAction: Set replicas to at least 2 for services requiring availability
